description: Held-out router set. 24 requests, 8 per action, written 2026-11-21 BEFORE the router prompt fix and never used to tune it. Same label definitions as eval/routes.json. Report it next to the main set so a prompt change tuned on the main set's misses can be checked on requests it never saw.
labelling_notes: Search boundary items are deliberately fact-like (they would still be wrong to answer from memory), to catch a fix that overcorrects away from SearchWeb.
